title: Alive vs Ready
description:
The Service kept sending kiosk traffic to pods that were still warming up — and never restarted ones that wedged.

Wire readiness and liveness probes (HTTP / TCP / exec as the brief says). Ready means “take traffic.” Alive means “restart me if I freeze.” Broken probe paths fail.

**Meant for:** Readiness + liveness probes.

problemStatement.brief: Wire readiness and liveness probes so traffic only hits ready pods and stuck processes get restarted.
